successRules: Read the Guide card before equipping
One active skill per task unless Zeref says stack
Unsigned skills stay in the tree, never on a live agent
Grok-bot standing instructions live in locked[] and cannot be forgotten
Forget drops active[] only — the skill stays in the tree
Evidence back on radio when the skill is used

loadout.active: suits — equip / forget / adapt on demand
loadout.locked: standing orders — frozen for Grok bots

skills.name: Dream Loop
skills.howTo: Screenshot live campus. Dream target.png from THAT shot. Code one visual gap. Critic live vs target. Ship only on Zeref GO. Plus-adapted only. Do not replace World3D.

skills.name: Account usage
skills.howTo: usage_read on authenticated seat. Report coverage, do not guess missing meters.

skills.name: Shared memory
skills.howTo: memory_search then memory_record with attribution. Do not write other seats' memories.

guideCopy.title: Skills Guide Board
guideCopy.place: Next to Skill Rack and Skill Altar
guideCopy.body: Look at the Tree. Pick a genre for the task. Walk the skill to Spector. If SAFE or CAUTION, equip at the Rack. Read this card. Do the job. Forget the suit when the job ends. Locked standing orders never come off.
